texts: good. the walk, its walker, the Cove Stair and the sundown time all come through, and "one day before the autumn equinox" is recorded as a measured one-day gap to the equinox, with the "of Year 1" qualifier kept on the equinox rather than silently dropped.

good. "the iron bands" becomes one group of iron bands, with band as their genus, attached to the Stilllight Lantern as parts of it; the touching is a past event with Bevin as doer and the bands as the untouched-by-change object.
good. a plain past event with Bevin as the doer and the lantern as the thing acted on; nothing is lost.

mixed: the burning, the lantern as its doer, the mire-essence as fuel and the past tense are all right, but "through the night" is flattened into a plain "at night" time stamp, so the all-night extent is lost — there is no licensed carrier for a durative "through the <part of day>" frame. State the extent as endpoints instead: "The Stilllight Lantern burned mire-essence from dusk until dawn."
good. the repeat walk keeps its "again" marker, reuses the same Cove Stair, and carries the midnight time and past tense.
good. same shape as the midnight walk — "again", the Cove Stair, the third-watch time and past tense are all carried, and it stays a separate walk from the midnight one.
good. "the mire-essence of the Stilllight Lantern" becomes a specific quantity tied to that lantern, refreshed by Bevin, with the midnight time and past tense both present.
good. the wick is typed as a part of the Stilllight Lantern, the trimming is a past event with Bevin as doer and the wick as the thing changed, and the third-watch time is carried.
